junction loss and other design-code settings
assumptions: n = 0.013, a common RCP value; the report does not print n.
Starting HGL at critical depth: the printed HGL Dn 1389.77 is the downstream invert plus about 1.02 ft, the critical depth of 7.07 cfs in an 18-in pipe.

The printed velocity 4.76 ft/s is read as the average of the downstream and upstream velocities (the manual's FL DOT report defines its velocity that way); the tabulation column is not defined in the excerpt.
notes: Informational qualitative comparison of the one-line standard step under stated assumptions. Do not tune n or the method to these printed values.
